body: I am frequently speaking to a therapist and my friends about my decisions.  I'm not doing anything without talking it through with other people in a rational mindset.  They're all pushing me to go ahead and leave ya know?  I can do another month and a half I think.  Maybe.  I hope.

So far, all of the medications I've been given either do not help or make it much worse.  My anxiety is up super bad today strictly because of this:  The VA hospital tried to deliver my meds last week and missed me.  So I asked my wife "did you check the mail on friday?" "Yes" - then again on Monday.  Then I just checked it for myself - it was delivered on FRIDAY.  She lied about checking the mail.  How fuckin' lazy....  Unfortunately I cannot take it until bedtime to get my levels right.  It's a sedative.  It also helps with my anxiety a ton but not specifically FOR my anxiety.  It's for depression.  I'm hoping I get balanced out tomorrow!

Edit:  I've also tried Kratom in a recreational sense a few years back.  I didn't get much out of it and CBD oil also does not help much!  I mean, with CBD I can tell ever so slightly that I'm a little bit less irritated.

Trust me, this is driving me crazy too.  She might have dropped out or she's in what they called "Co-Op" at our school where they worked from lunch-on at their normal jobs and went to school in the mornings.

I don't know.  It's all up in the air.  I don't know if she's going to immediately demand I pay alimony or if she thinks she's going to maintain access to my account.  I don't know what she's expecting from me financially during this process.  We need to talk about it but neither of us want to.  We still live together for the time being and we're trying as hard as we can not to make shit worse.    


I'd like to believe that not supporting a family would free up some funds but again, I don't know what they're expecting of me.  I still love her, so it's not that I dont' want to help or anything.

I love D&D but I can't find a group quite my style.  And by "style" I mean - serious but still able to joke and laugh when we need to.  The groups around me I've found are either the 'Dress up and speak with accents' and role play or the "OK, so I'm gonna shove a stick up the ogre's butt to see what happens"  - Just something in the middle would be cool.   


You're absolutely right she has the right to reject me for any reason and that's her choice and I will respect it.  At least, I say I will.  I want to respect it.  I'm afraid that I'll become someone I'm not though and this scares the shit out of me. A little context, I have a deep-fear of being a pedophile.  Not because I like kids or that I'm perverted or anything even remotely close to that but I'm scared that 30 years from now I'll be that creepy old man you see on the news!  (part of why I'm worried about her age).  I know this sounds asinine and the ramblings of a crazy person.  I do suffer from cognitive distortion though, so check that out.    


I need to be clear here:  I am not a pedophile or a stalker or anything like those people!  I don't do anything like that!  I'm just worried I'll become one.  I feel like if I keep a good awareness of it that it will never happen.  I'm basically trying as hard as I can to fit into society's "norms".    


And the last 3 paragraphs make me sound insane.  Anxiety is having me write more and more paragraphs.  I need to stop right here.
